notesZh:
断线保护：
- 引擎意外停止、重启或切换配置时，网关设为本路由器的设备会被挡住上网，不会偷偷直连；只有在面板点「停止」才改为直连。
- 引擎起不来时，首页红色提示，可直接重启引擎、恢复到最近的健康配置、查看原因，或停止 EdgeNest 让设备直连。
- 面板打不开时，经 SSH 运行 /etc/init.d/edgenest-router stop 也能让设备恢复直连。
- 守护进程异常退出后，残留的旧引擎会被自动清理并重新接管。
健康快照：
- 你改过配置并稳定运行 10 分钟、经代理能上网后，自动保存一份，保留最近 10 份；订阅刷新、CDN 换地址不会另存。
- 在「设置 → 数据 → 健康快照」一键恢复；恢复前会先保存当前状态。面板打不开时可经 SSH 运行 edgenest-routerd restore latest。
其他：
- 在线升级时，代理核心有更新也会一并安装（以前只更新主程序）。
- 点「重启」后显示「已重启」。
- 引擎监听的端口一律只对局域网和组网接口开放，广域网侧不可达。
- 断开、重连或切换线路后，设备上的网页能马上恢复（代理内部的临时地址缓存时间缩短到 1 秒）。
- 内置规则更新到 10 月 30 日。
订阅：
- 以前添加、没有开启定时刷新的订阅，升级后默认每 6 小时自动刷新一次；之后手动关掉的不会再被打开。
notesEn:
Kill switch:
- When the engine stops unexpectedly, restarts or switches configuration, devices using this router as gateway are blocked instead of silently going direct; only Stop in the panel sends them direct.
- If the engine will not start, the overview shows a red notice with restart, restore the latest healthy configuration, the reason, and stop EdgeNest so devices go direct.
- With the panel unreachable, running /etc/init.d/edgenest-router stop over SSH also sends devices direct.
- After the daemon exits abnormally, a leftover engine is cleaned up and taken over automatically.
Health snapshots:
- After you change the configuration and it runs for 10 minutes with the proxy reaching the internet, a copy is saved automatically; the latest 10 are kept, and subscription refreshes or CDN address changes do not add new ones.
- Restore with one click under Settings → Data → Health snapshots; the current state is saved first. With the panel unreachable, run edgenest-routerd restore latest over SSH.
Other:
- Online upgrades now also install an updated proxy core (previously only the main program).
- Restart now confirms with "Restarted".
- Every port the engine listens on is reachable only from the LAN and mesh interfaces, never from the WAN side.
- Pages on devices recover right after a disconnect, reconnect or line change (the proxy's temporary addresses are now cached for 1 second).
- Built-in rules updated to October 30.
Subscriptions:
- Subscriptions added earlier without background refresh now refresh every 6 hours after the upgrade; switching it off afterwards sticks.
